correctness.rationale: For every even \(n\ge4\), Walsh inversion gives exactly \(F_\theta=F_0+\theta n!\prod_j a_j\). The independent even moment is strictly convex in logarithmic absolute coefficients; permutation Jensen yields \(F_0\ge M_n\prod_j|a_j|\), with iff flat equality when nonzero. This proves sharp relative endpoints. A tilted even-lattice variable \(X\) has mean one, variance \(r^2\), lattice span two: local CLT supplies the exact leading prefactor. Exact-rational tests on n=4,6,8 completed 293 assertions; finite tests are not the proof.
